summary: Vistagen Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing topline results from a Phase 2 exploratory study of fasedienol nasal spray for social anxiety disorder. The study met its safety objective with no new findings; active arms showed numerical but not statistically significant separation from placebo. A prespecified analysis of very severe patients (LSAS≥95) showed nominally significant responses. This is a routine clinical trial update, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or structural changes are involved.
